description: This file contains the implementation of the Materialize JavaScript library, including DOM manipulation utilities, component base class, and specific components like Collapsible, as well as some utility functions for event handling and animations.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A base class for all Materialize components, managing instantiation, destruction, and multiple element handling.

classes.name: Collapsible
classes.description: A component class extending the base Component, managing collapsible (accordion/expandable) UI elements with animation and event handling.

classes.name: Collapsible
classes.description: A component class managing collapsible UI elements with animated open/close, event handling, and accordion behavior.

classes.name: Dropdown
classes.description: A component class managing dropdown menus with positioning, focus, keyboard navigation, and event handling.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: A component class implementing modal dialogs with overlay, animations, focus trapping, and multiple modals support.

classes.name: Materialbox
classes.description: A component class for image lightbox effect with zoom-in/out animations and overlay.

classes.name: Parallax
classes.description: A component class for background parallax scrolling effect based on scroll position.

classes.name: Tabs
classes.description: A component class for tab navigation with responsive, swipeable, and indicator features.

classes.name: Tabs
classes.description: A component class managing tab navigation with responsive, swipeable, and indicator features.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: A component class for tooltip UI elements with position, delay, and accessibility features.

classes.name: Waves
classes.description: A library implementing wave/ripple click effects on UI elements.

classes.name: Toast
classes.description: A class managing transient notification messages with animations and dismiss controls.

classes.name: Sidenav
classes.description: A component class managing side navigation drawers with overlay, swipe, and responsiveness.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: A component class that tracks scroll position to highlight active navigation links.

classes.name: Autocomplete
classes.description: A component class providing autocompletion suggestions on input fields.

classes.name: Chips
classes.description: A component class for managing chip UI elements, including creation, deletion, autocomplete integration, and keyboard navigation.

classes.name: Pushpin
classes.description: A component class that pins elements to fixed positions (top, bottom, or pinned) during scroll, with position callbacks.

classes.name: FloatingActionButton
classes.description: A component class handling floating action buttons with expandable menus and toolbar transition effects.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: A component class for date selection UI with extensive options, internationalization, and event callbacks.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: A component class providing date selection UI with extensive options, internationalization, event callbacks, and DOM management.

classes.name: Timepicker
classes.description: A component class providing time selection UI with analog and digital styles, extensive options, internationalization, and event callbacks.

classes.name: CharacterCounter
classes.description: A component class managing a character counter UI for input fields with validation and visual feedback.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: A component class implementing a touch/mouse-friendly carousel/slider with indicators, touch gestures, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: A component class implementing a touch/mouse-friendly carousel/slider with indicators, touch gestures, and responsive behavior. Contains methods for handling indicator clicks, resize events, height adjustments, position calculations, scrolling, cycling, and navigation controls.

methods.name: _ypos
methods.description: Retrieves the Y coordinate from an event, supporting both touch and mouse events.

methods.description: Wraps an index within the bounds of the slide count, providing cyclic navigation.

methods.name: _track
methods.description: Tracks scrolling velocity for smoother animations during drag gestures.

methods.description: Automatically scrolls to the nearest slide based on velocity and animation parameters.

methods.description: Performs the actual scroll to a specified position with animation, updating active classes and triggers cycle callbacks.
